canonical_name: Recovery Activities and Progress Not Communicated to Stakeholders
description: Recovery activities and progress are not communicated to stakeholders.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for recovery operations conducted without stakeholder status updates, progress reports, or communication plans. Look for gaps in internal notifications to leadership, external updates to partners/customers, or regulatory reporting during recovery phases.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
